d:
Mumbai ke Colaba mein sthit Mukesh Mills kabhi ek chalti hui textile mill thi. Lekin 1982 ki bhayankar aag ke baad is jagah ki pehchaan badal gayi. Waqt ke saath yeh jagah apni haunted stories ke liye mashhoor hone lagi.
Kehte hain ki ek horror show ki shooting ke dauraan ek actress ko wahan kuch aisa nazar aaya, jise dekhkar poori crew ke hosh ud gaye. Camera mein dikha ek jala hua chehra, apne aap chalti machinery aur ek aisi awaaz jisne sabko mill chhodne par majboor kar diya. Aakhir us raat Mukesh Mills mein kya hua tha? Kya wahan kisi adhoori kahani ka saaya aaj bhi maujood hai?
